name: 班级活动方案
description_zh: 为班主任生成完整的班级活动方案：节日庆祝、主题班会、团建、研学、毕业季等，含目标、流程、资源、安全预案、反思框架；强调全员参与与教育意义。触发关键词：班级活动方案、节日活动、主题班会、团建活动、研学活动、运动会方案、活动策划。
description_en: Generates complete class activity plans for homeroom teachers: festival celebrations, themed class meetings, team-building, study trips, graduation season, etc., including objectives, procedures, resources, safety plans, and reflection frameworks; emphasizes full participation and educational value. Trigger keywords: class activity plan, festival activity, themed class meeting, team-building activity, study trip, sports meet plan, event planning.
